description: Establish a green baseline before implementing Issue #19. Confirm the toolchain, install deps if needed, and run the existing build/test/synth so later regressions are attributable to this task. This is an existing project so a baseline is mandatory.
steps: Confirm npm via the nvm PATH prefix: run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm -v` and `node -v` from repo root /projects/sandbox/kiro-mlb-postseason.
If node_modules looks stale, run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm install` at the repo root (workspaces install).
Run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build` and confirm the ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra build succeeds (frontend/dist is produced).
Run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test` and confirm all vitest suites pass.
Run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run synth` and confirm cdk synth succeeds with no AWS calls.
Install the Playwright chromium browser once if not present: `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npx playwright install chromium` (run from frontend workspace or repo root).
Record the baseline results in this feature's findings field. Do not commit anything in this feature (no source changes).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 and frontend/dist exists.
`npm test` exits 0 with all suites passing.
findings: GREEN baseline established on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site (HEAD 9356096). Toolchain: node v22.23.3, npm 11.4.2 (via nvm PATH prefix). node_modules already present; no npm install needed. `npm run build` exit 0: ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra all compiled; frontend/dist produced (index.html + assets, vite built in ~6.8s). `npm test` exit 0: all vitest suites pass across workspaces. Frontend workspace: 25 test files, 188 tests passed. Infra workspace: 1 file, 8 tests passed (shared/backend suites also ran green). Note: infra tests emit a non-fatal CDK WARNING that Lambda runtime nodejs20.x is deprecated (W2531) - pre-existing, not a failure. `npm run synth` exit 0: cdk synth produced MlbPostseasonStack template with no AWS calls (62 unconfigured feature flags noted, informational only). Playwright chromium installed via `npx playwright install chromium` (OS not officially supported -> fallback ubuntu24.04-x64 build downloaded, exit 0). No source changes made; nothing committed per feature scope.
